correctness.rationale: The algebraic statements checked are correct: regrouping by gcd(n,v) cycles gives the claimed chi_ell product, reverse-complement conjugates the second canonical block to ordinary chi, inverse degree separates effective block lengths, and order/iterate/fixed-point formulas transfer under genuine conjugacy for the canonical families. The order expression 2^floor(log2 ell) agrees with 2^ceil(log2((ell+1)/2)) for odd ell.

originality.rationale: The package no longer has a defensible standalone originality claim. Feng–Wang–Yu–Zhang v2 explicitly states the interleaved-track decomposition and elementary equivalence. The earlier 18 September SCOPE record already preserves the inherited invariant consequences after crediting v2, while the stronger same-day record `generalized-chi-affine-product-decomposition--7580e8e0e8e1` contains the same affine-class mechanism and additional linear/differential results. This record is therefore substantively subsumed.

scientific_value.rationale: Although correct, the package adds no sufficiently distinct theorem beyond the prior repaired generalized-chi record and the stronger same-day affine-product record. Maintaining it as a separate accepted finding would fragment and duplicate the same contribution. Archiving it as a failed/withdrawn attempt preserves provenance without inflating the validated corpus.
